project:
Clear the board of all of the tiles by clicking 2 or more matching tiles that are adjacent to each other vertically or horizontally. The boards start out with tiles more than one deep. When the last tile in a stack is removed the tiles above it will drop down. If matches are made when the tiles drop you will get another Magic Pumpkin.  Magic Pumpkns are used to destroy tiles when no matches are available.

If you get stuck and have hints left, click the Help button and the available match will move back and forth so you can see it.

The amount of tiles in a stack can be determined by looking at the edge of the stack.

Use the Clear Data button on this screen to clear the highscore.
